counterexample_attempts: At p=103,d=101, finite enumeration was used only to search for errors. It matched the claimed 1,081,912 accepted incidences, degree census, moment values, and connectivity.
The all-concurrent and parallel-seed configurations satisfy P10's concurrency charge; no counterexample to Theorem 2 was found.
The concentrated-direction construction was recomputed: it gives point degree k and can put K_{p,p} inside H without contradicting raw-incidence K_{2,2}-freeness.
P11's prose fails an integrality check: any strictly positive lower bound on an integer common-neighbor count guarantees at least one raw target, even when the bound tends to zero.

The abstract's claim about every reaching family is false literally. Taking weight 1 on every line is reaching but can have weight asymptotically larger than p/epsilon; only OPT_theta is Theta(theta p/epsilon).
No excluded degree case was examined.

summary: Revise. The intended Theorems 1–2 are mathematically correct in dimension 2 over every prime-field parameter 101<=d<p, and the explicit carrier has the valid single decoder Q=0. However, the exact SHA-bound statement omits essential quantifiers, P11 falsely infers that a positive bound below one guarantees no raw target, and the abstract overstates an OPT bound as applying to every feasible family. These are repairable; no fatal obstruction or counterexample to the core theorems was found. The benchmark remains exactly exponent 1/3 and is not improved.
